snippet.title: Mobsteria // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858540/Mobsteria/

A strategic text-based crime game where you build a criminal empire from the ground up. Execute heists, recruit associates, craft weapons, and compete against players in this deep browser-based game. Rise from street thug to crime boss through tactical decision-making and ruthless ambition.

Developed by
JRichards
